run_flux2_text_to_image: run the Flux2Pipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable steps and guidance
run_flux2_image_to_image: run the Flux2Pipeline to generate images from input images with text prompts for image-to-image generation
run_flux2_caption_upsample: run the Flux2Pipeline with caption upsampling to refine prompts before image generation
run_flux2_encode_prompt: run the encode_prompt method to generate text embeddings and text IDs from prompts
run_flux2_prepare_latents: run the prepare_latents method to generate and pack latent tensors for diffusion
